name: questions.delivery_strategy.baseline
description: Baseline questions for delivery model, team topology, release cadence.

questions.text: Which delivery model applies (Scrum, Kanban, Shape Up, waterfall, hybrid)?
questions.rationale: Delivery model shapes cadence, ceremony cost, and estimation approach.

questions.text: What is the current team topology (stream-aligned, platform, enabling teams)?
questions.rationale: Team Topologies mapping reveals cognitive-load and ownership problems early.

questions.text: Are the engineering teams internal, external (vendor), or mixed?
questions.rationale: Staffing shape changes the levers we have for effort estimation and team proposals.

questions.text: What is the target sprint or delivery cadence?
questions.rationale: Cadence affects batch size, risk exposure per release, and on-call burden.
